lines.text: Via delle Fornaci 7 · Borgo Valdorso (TO) · Production plant
During the transfer of acetone from a 200 L drum on a plastic-wheeled
dolly into tank T-5, the operator saw a spark at the drum bung when
the transfer nozzle touched it. No ignition.
The drum was electrically isolated by the plastic wheels. Acetone
